messages.author: Vaibhav Dixit
messages.body:
Dear All,
I'm unable to find benchmarks for the RTX A4000 16gb card.
Thus can someone on the list please share their experience with this card
and is it expected to be 2 x faster than for e.g. a RTX 2080 ti 8gb card.
Benchmarks for RTX A5000 and A6000 show only a marginal improvement, thus
I'm not sure what to expect from the A4000 16gb cards.
Looking forward to valuable suggestions from the list.
Thank you and best regards.
Regards,
Dr. Vaibhav A. Dixit,
